Market today: The tech sector is showing mixed signals. While Anthropic's IPO brings some positive AI sentiment, a significant AI sell-off hit Asian tech, and widespread outages are a concern. The mood is volatile, with underlying weakness in your core holdings.

Your holdings: Your portfolio is heavily exposed to tech/chip names, many of which are leveraged ETFs, amplifying losses. SOXL (-79.84%), MUU (-64.05%), and SMCI (-45.67%) are showing severe drawdowns. Remember, margin trading makes these drops hurt extra.

Watch: Keep an eye on the broader AI sector's reaction to the Anthropic IPO, as well as any continuation of the "AI sell-off" that hit Asian markets. These will dictate the near-term direction for your concentrated book.

Bottom line: Focus intensely on risk management and stop-loss adherence, especially with your leveraged positions.
plays: MSFU: Consider trimming or exiting if it breaks below its 35.7 stop, given its leveraged nature and SELL status.
METU: Trim this leveraged ETF if it approaches its 18.3 stop, as it's already flagged TRIM.
SOXL: Re-evaluate your stop for this deeply negative, leveraged position; the current 200 stop is irrelevant at 45.3.
